title: The tortoise library
alt: A gentle tortoise carries a miniature wooden library across a flowering watercolor meadow.
description: Fantasy architecture follows a natural animal form in a finely detailed illustrated landscape.
prompt: A richly designed original fantasy illustration of a large gentle tortoise walking through a flowering meadow. A tiny wooden traveling library is built securely on top of its shell, with curved bookcases, an arched door and a small porch that follow the shell shape. The tortoise has one natural head, four attached legs and a small tail; its shell remains visible beneath the library. Intricate plants, butterflies and distant rolling hills, refined watercolor and soft cinematic light, complete animal visible, no text or people.
